status.description: success: the plan (or fix list) was implemented and local checks passed. plan_rejected: implementing revealed the plan is wrong; nothing was left half-done. failed: could not complete; explain in summary.

summary.description: What was implemented, in a few sentences. For failed, what blocked.

changed_files.description: Every repository-relative path you created, modified, or deleted. Must match the worktree exactly; the runner cross-checks it.

tests_written.description: Each new or modified test, with the behavior it asserts.

failed_before_fix.description: True when the test was run before the fix and failed for the planned reason; null when not applicable (regression-only test).

commands_run.description: Test, lint, typecheck, and build commands actually executed, with their outcome.

plan_deviations.description: Anywhere the implementation differs from the plan on purpose, with the reason. Silent deviations are a defect.

brief_gaps.description: Anything the context brief was missing or wrong about. Non-blocking; tells the planner what to add next time.

rejection_reason.description: Required for plan_rejected: why the plan cannot be implemented as written (root cause misidentified, impossible change, breaks an unlisted caller).
